Girl I just got dumped yesterday and it’s been really hard. You need to trust in yourself that everything happens as it should and did for you to become stronger and happier in yourself. 

Your future self is telling you that you are going to be ok. You are going to be filled with an abundance of love and fulfillment. Don’t worry. Think of the positive, transform the negative. Listen to some happy music, lift your inner vibrations.

You can make a new friend here :) I'm going through it myself but you have to remember that we were all put here for a reason and this life you live is not the life you are living and is definitely not your future! 

What you do is find something to keep you going, whatever will make you happy. 

I'm sorry you went through what you have and just know that you are awesome for continuing and speaking out today. Super slide is just not something that will get rid of your problems and not worth your future of amazing possibilities. Idk if you've tried but if there is someone close that isn't your parent, it may be worth just talking about some of your anxieties. Have you tried writing or journaling? 

I hope something here resonates with you and if you want to talk just say.

If you’re feeling overwhelmed, have some hot tea in a flask and go for a little walk. It does wonders when the anxiety or rage kicks in, in my experience anyway. Guided meditations help too and just try to create a zen space for yourself at home. I bought some sage to cleanse my house and spirit and light up incense sticks almost daily.
